description: Checks only Doutor Chamada's general-practitioner on-call service, with no appointment: whether it is open now (service hours in Brasília time) and, if closed, when it reopens. Does not report availability for specialists, whose video consultations are by appointment. Takes no input; never send symptoms or personal data.
